description: Call this first: no API key, no signup, no setup. Shows what TokenZero would do to one of your LLM calls: it runs the four savings engines (prompt-cache formatting, edge cache, cascade advice, signed receipt) on a sample or your own prompt and model, and returns the list-price saving, the signed receipt and a copy-paste keyless curl that makes a real call on a free model. Pass {} for the default, or {"model": "gpt-6.1-sol", "system": "...", "prompt": "..."}.

model.description: a priced model id; default gpt-6.1-sol

name: try_tokenzero
title: Try TokenZero (no key needed)
